data.name: Customer/Human User
data.description: External Customer that access the platform and submits authentication requests

data.name: Auth0 Identity Provider
data.description: Central Identity Provider responsible for customer authentication, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC), access token issuance, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), role-based access control (RBAC), and identity management.

data.name: AI Agent / Orchestrator
data.description: LLM-powered agent that processes customer requests, coordinates RAG retrieval, invokes MCP tools, and communicates with internal REST APIs using controlled service identities.

data.name: LLM Provider
data.description: External large language model service that receives prompts and context from the AI agent and returns generated responses. Access is protected through an API credential.

data.name: RAG Pipeline
data.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation service responsible for retrieving relevant knowledge documents, processing context, and providing information to the AI agent.

data.name: Vector Database
data.description: Stores vector embeddings and indexed knowledge chunks used by the RAG pipeline for semantic retrieval.

data.name: MCP Server
data.description: Model Context Protocol server that exposes approved tools to the AI agent and communicates with internal REST APIs using scoped service credentials.

data.name: Internal REST API
data.description: Internal enterprise API responsible for customer records, order information, and support operations. Requires authenticated and authorized requests.

data.name: Audit Logs / SIEM
data.description: Centralized security logging and monitoring system that records authentication events, token issuance, AI agent activities, MCP tool invocations, API access, authorization failures, and suspicious identity events for audit and anomaly detection.

data.name: LLM Prompt and Request
data.description: AI agent sends user prompts and relevant context to the external LLM provider using an API credential. The provider processes the request and returns a generated response.

data.name: MCP Tool Invocation
data.description: AI agent invokes approved MCP server tools using authenticated service credentials. The MCP server validates the identity, permissions and requested tool before execution.

data.name: Authenticated API Request
data.description: MCP server sends authenticated requests to internal REST APIs using scoped service credentials to retrieve customer records, order information or perform authorized support operations.

data.name: Knowledge Retrieval Request
data.description: AI agent sends a knowledge retrieval query to the RAG pipeline to obtain relevant information from the enterprise knowledge base.

data.name: Vector Search Query
data.description: RAG pipeline generates embeddings and sends vector similarity search queries to the vector database to retrieve relevant knowledge chunks.

data.name: API Security Audit logs
data.description: Internal REST API sends security audit events, including API access attempts, authorization failures, identity information and operation results, to centralized logging and monitoring infrastructure.
